_provenance.note: Pennsylvania citation authorities. The SNAP Handbook cites its own sections as plain decimal numbers (e.g. '512.1', '540.351', '560.8'), with Appendices cited by chapter + letter (e.g. '536 Appendix A'). This pack prefixes numbered sections 'PAH <section>' to disambiguate, matching the pattern this roster already uses for other single-manual states' prefixes (Wisconsin's FSH, Illinois' PM/WAG, Michigan's BEM/BAM). Appendices are folded into the known set as their own literal strings since their citation shape (chapter number + 'Appendix' + letter) does not fit the plain-decimal regex.
